result = spark.sql(
    f"""
    MERGE INTO {target_fqn} AS t
    USING {view_name} AS s
    ON {on}
    WHEN MATCHED AND {changed_condition(business)} THEN UPDATE SET *
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT *
    """
)
